asset.assumptions: Proxy geometry/masses; spring-return lever; runtime joint-limit latch, not a bolt simulation

mount.frame: the camera's colour optical frame, expressed in the arm's Link6 frame
mount.convention: optical axes ROS (x right, y down, z forward); rpy is ZYX, Rz(yaw)Ry(pitch)Rx(roll)
mount.source: wrist_mount.json (the saved default): d1_ui mount editor on lukas-ROG-Zephyrus-G16-GA605WI-GA605WI (aligned by eye, not measured: the operator aligned the CAD camera against the wrist in the console's 3D view; no target, no hand-eye procedure, no image evidence)

body_asset.frame: colour optical: x right, y down, z forward, origin at the colour sensor
